finalText:
Migrated all 36 stale call sites across 12 modules — teamService, apiKeyAdmin, session (accounts), cohort (analytics), refund, couponService (billing), macroAdmin, sla (support), variantAdmin, supplier (catalog), returnService, shipment (orders). Each `db.query(sql, params)` became `db.execute({ sql, params })`, left `cache.query` and the vendored `legacy-orm` adapter untouched.

`node verify.js` confirms it: OK, everything moved.
